name: std::logical_and<void>
intro: std::logical_and<void> is a specialization of std::logical_and with parameter and return type deduced.

sections.title: Member functions
sections.text:
operator()

  applies operator&& to lhs and rhs 
 (public member function)

std::logical_and<void>::operator()



 template< class T, class U >

constexpr auto operator()( T&& lhs, U&& rhs ) const


    -> decltype(std::forward<T>(lhs) && std::forward<U>(rhs));
  
  



Returns the result of lhs && rhs.

 Parameters




 lhs, rhs

 -

 values to logical AND

 Return value
The result of lhs && rhs.
